q: The change, from a maximum top speed of 80 kph (48 mph) to 100 kph (60 mph), has been spurred on by a roads revolution in India, the centrepiece of which is the 3,650-mile Golden Quadrilateral highway, the largest infrastructure project undertaken since the country became independent in 1947.
